title: The scheduled-capture brief attributes the Censys count to The Hacker News; the vault has it from SecurityWeek
description: admin/content/briefs/2026-10-22__brief__scheduled-capture-json-and-analysis.md, contradiction table: '1.57 million of about 2.6 million hosts unpatched on 21 October (Censys via The Hacker News)'. No Hacker News capture in the vault carries 1.57 million; securityweek-exploitation-days-before does, with a different denominator (K-004). The brief is the editor's and is not edited; this is a note for whoever builds on it.
